ترتقبون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقِبُونَ (tartaqibūna) /tar.ta.qi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# تُرْتَقَبُونَ (turtaqabūna) /tur.ta.qa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
